$comment: Last-seen state for scripts/regulatory-watch.cjs. Committed, so the observation history is itself auditable. `sources` is machine-written. `acknowledgedBlocked` is HUMAN-authored and preserved across runs: it is the ratchet. A blocked source listed there is a known procurement gap and downgrades to a WARN in scripts/regulatory-freshness.cjs; a source that goes blocked WITHOUT an entry here turns `pnpm checkup` RED. That asymmetry is the point — a permanently-red gate is one people learn to skip, but a NEW coverage regression must be impossible to sit on. Removing an entry here is how you re-arm a source once it is fixed.
